snaive.not_evaluated_reason: Needs at least 12 training months; only 9 are available.

distribution_plan.method: Split of the level forecast by each series' share of the last 3 months.

seasonality_trend.answer: The latest month (2023-07) sold 5,661 units (-6.8% versus the previous month). The last three months averaged 5,758 units, +32.6% versus the three months before; the peak so far was 2023-06 (6,072 units). Summer months averaged 5,414 units against 3,935 in winter (+37.6%). With only 12 months of history, no calendar month has been seen often enough to separate seasonality from the launch ramp-up (24 months are needed), so none of the models could learn the seasonal pattern yet; they extrapolate the recent level or trend. On the test window (2023-05 to 2023-07) the best model's bias was -13.8%, i.e. it under-forecast that period.

best_model.answer: Naive and ARIMA tie for best with WAPE 13.8% (MAPE 13.7%) on the 3-month test window. ARIMA chose ARIMA(0,1,0), a random walk, so its forecasts are identical to Naive. With only 9 training months the most reliable signal was the latest level. Random Forest (WAPE 20.3%, bias -20.3%) and XGBoost (WAPE 22.5%, bias -22.5%) learned from 63 pooled rows but under-forecast the test window: with so little history they had seen few comparable months, and tree models cannot extrapolate beyond the levels they were trained on. XGBoost was weakest (WAPE 22.5%).

recommendations.title: Production volume and buffer
recommendations.detail: Plan production for 2023-08 to 2023-10 around the Naive forecast (2023-08: 5,661, 2023-09: 5,661, 2023-10: 5,661; 16,983 units in total). Keep capacity or stock up to the Naive 80% upper bound (2023-08: 6,546, 2023-09: 6,912, 2023-10: 7,194) so a demand surprise does not cause stockouts.

recommendations.title: Regional and channel allocation
recommendations.detail: Allocate the 16,983 planned units by region: PL-Central 5,644 units (33.2%); PL-North 5,974 units (35.2%); PL-South 5,365 units (31.6%). By channel: Discount 33.3%; E-commerce 34.1%; Retail 32.5%.

recommendations.title: Availability and promotions
recommendations.detail: Stockouts cost an estimated 514 units in the last three months (20 store-days out of stock); raise safety stock before peak months. Promotion days sell 1.92x a normal day, so use promotions to lift off-season demand rather than to add to the summer peak.

recommendations.title: Re-forecast monthly
recommendations.detail: Re-run the forecast every month as actuals arrive (data currently runs to 2023-07). Until 24 months exist, use the simple model as the planning baseline and treat machine-learning outputs as a cross-check.

caveats: Synthetic data: SKU JU-021 (a juice) stands in for the flavored water, so patterns are illustrative.
Short history: 12 months of data and a 3-month test window make error estimates noisy.
Random Forest's range is a heuristic spread of its trees and XGBoost has no uncertainty range.
